headline: Far fewer United flights are in the air than usual right now.

items.text: The 174 United flights in the air are 73% fewer than usual for this time of day: over the past 7 days, the median at this hour was 651.

A ground delay program is holding flights into San Francisco until 11:59 PM PT because of wind; delays average 138 minutes, up to 690 minutes. Los Angeles has the lowest on-time share of the seven hubs reporting so far today.

Weather is affecting operations at Newark, with somewhat low clouds or visibility and rain that can cause minor delays. The FAA's operations plan says a ground stop or ground delay program is possible for flights into Newark until 10:00 PM ET, but it is not in effect.

Other airports have programs too: a ground stop is holding flights into Toronto (YYZ) until 6:15 PM ET, and the FAA rates the chance of an extension as high. Ground delay programs also hold flights into Boston until 9:59 PM ET, into New York LaGuardia until 10:59 PM ET, and into San Diego.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to San Francisco, check your flight status before leaving for the airport; the same goes for Toronto, Boston, New York LaGuardia and San Diego.
